provenance.post_title: Paizo Organized Play Seeks New Organizers!
provenance.asset_description: Two separate character illustrations over the top of a blurred background. On the right of the image is A mushroom leshy wearing a Pathfinder society vest and a white scarf, above him in the Pathfinder Society Text logo and below him is the Org Play Foundation text logo. On the left of the image a pale half elf with a short, silver hair wearing a black and purple space suite, stands with her hands on her hips while looking sternly at the viewer, under the half elf is the Starfinder Society text logo.
